Week 1, May 2, 2026 in At home MTC

Week 0.5-- It's official!

Goodness Gonkcious, I can't believe I'm finally a missionary! For those who don't know (or just forgot because you don't care enough about me), I'm going to serve in the Florida Tampa mission-- English speaking. I got set apart as a missionary Tuesday night and started home training on Wednesday.

On Wednesday, I started my online classes and met my companions and district (the group of missionaries I am training with) over zoom. I'm in a trio, so I have two companions: Sister Nelson and SIster Smith-- who are the absolute BEST! (and I'm not just saying that because they're getting this email, too). Sister Nelson is coming to Florida with me and Sister Smith is going to Pennsylvania.

On Thursday and Friday, we had more classes.It's kind of hard doing everything on zoom, so I'm excited to be in the Provo Mission Training Center (MTC) soon!

Also, please contact me, I would love to hear from you guys! You can reach out any day of the week, but I can only respond on p-days-- which are Saturdays during my time at the MTC and will be Mondays when I get out in the mission field (May 20th).

Spiritual thought: "Therefore, fear not, little flock; do good; let earth and hell combine against you, for if ye are built upon my rock, they cannot prevail." -Doctrine and Covenants 6:34 I love this scripture because I am somewhat scared to start my mission, but I know that God will give me the strength I need to do His work.

Love you guys! Sister Christison

(Sorry-- no photos yet. I'll get a Google Photos folder soon and put the link here next week.)
